synopsis: The skeptic’s review states that AI Act obligations for high-risk AI embedded in machinery apply from 2 August 2028 [f10453]. For collision-mitigation validation, the Act is a headline item for legal sign-off if applicable; the supplied facts do not establish whether this system falls within its scope [f10851]. The glossary recommends that the product liability reviewer obtain a notified-body or legal opinion covering both the EU Machinery Regulation and AI Act, alongside independent safety sign-off and a documented launch decision [f16567].

relations.note: Specifies the opinion and launch documentation accompanying legal sign-off.
Adds the application date for high-risk AI embedded in machinery.
